summary: Anticipatory bail under Section 438 CrPC; applicability of PMLA Section 45 bar; precedent conflict between Nikesh Tarachand Shah and Dr. V.C. Mohan; predicate offence dependency; nexus with accused via luxury travel and hawala channels; custodial interrogation necessity; predicate offence acquittal/discharge relevance; bail granted based on incorrect precedent interpretation; impugned order overturned.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act s.7 r/w s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; anticipatory bail set aside; High Court judgment quashed; custodial interrogation authorized.
